answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in raven, expire in velvet, and pigment lists each expiry. Anyone running 79 aliases thus needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3426 identities would post 4181 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
